1. Landing Page the Barbershop
The project was carried out according to the brief. The task was to develop a landing page without special technical requirements. It is important that the CTA be "book now". The landing included 9 blocks.
  - I did some initial web research first. I looked at what sites on the subject of barbershop and beauty salons are in Ukraine and the World. I looked at what mistakes there are on competing sites, how the blocks and features of the site are located.
  - The project was carried out in Figma. After researching, I started making wireframes, low and highly detailed.
  - Having started the design, at first I decided to make a logo in order to style the site under it. I selected the palette based on the brief, dark tones. A grotesque font that can emphasize "masculine brutality". Photos of bearded men in high quality.
  - Arranged the blocks so that the CTA would be in the "right place". This is the main screen, price and footer. Between them are blocks with information and triggers.

2. Website redesign. Hotel and restaurant complex.
The task of the project was to develop a completely new website. High quality images, only useful and relevant information, use corporate colors. Make a delivery menu and a shopping cart. Show all hotel rooms with the possibility of booking for a specific date.
  - Work on the project began with primary web research. Check out competitor sites. Found bugs and features.
  - The next stage is low and highly detailed prototypes. He paid special attention to navigation, delivery menus and room reservations.
  - The font was chosen in such a way that the grotesque and serif would be well combined with each other, there was no sharp "transition" between the fonts.
  - The project is made in Figma.

 3. Web service for online consultation of the doctor and the patient.
The idea of the project was: provide a web service interface for conducting online calls between a doctor and a patient; to enable the doctor in a private clinic to review the patient's medical history, schedule an appointment with the patient in the calendar, and conduct an online call between the doctor and the patient.

  - implemented all the requirements from the customer for the technical and visual part of the project

As a product designer at a rapidly growing startup, my work experience involved working closely with the engineering and product teams to design and launch a new mobile app. My responsibilities included conducting user research, creating wireframes and prototypes, and developing a visual design language that aligned with the brand's identity.
One of the unique challenges of this project was the need to design for a diverse user base, including both English and non-English speaking users. To address this challenge, I worked closely with a team of translators to ensure that all content was accurately translated and easily understood by all users.

Another unique aspect of this project was the need to design for accessibility, as a significant portion of the user base had varying degrees of visual impairments. To address this challenge, I conducted extensive research on accessibility best practices, and incorporated features such as high-contrast mode and voice-over functionality into the app design.
Throughout the design process, I worked closely with the engineering team to ensure that all design solutions were feasible and aligned with technical requirements. I also conducted extensive user testing and gathered feedback from users to iterate and refine the design.

Ultimately, the app was launched successfully, and received positive feedback from both English and non-English speaking users, as well as users with visual impairments. My work on this project helped to establish a design system and UX standards that could be applied to future products and features.
